276403731_be403f5d.text: The first cell type, projection neurons, are excitatory and glutamatergic, extending their axons outside the thalamus to target the cortex, striatum, and amygdala. As they exit the thalamus, these neurons send collaterals to specific subsections of the reticular nucleus [10]. Interestingly, there are no recurrent intra-thalamic excitatory inputs.
